premises.text: CRM yields garbage-in/garbage-out because sales reps skip data entry or let it go stale, leaving management without real pipeline transparency
premises.evidence_span: it's garbage in, neatly packaged garbage out

premises.text: Fortuit's plugin automatically captures emails, IMs, contacts, and activities and combines them with the pipeline into a predictive model of how the rep sells
premises.evidence_span: it was taking all of the unstructured data, all of my emails, activities, IMs, contacts, putting that information, combining it with my sales pipeline to build a predictive model about the way I sell

premises.text: The engine flags at-risk deals with reasons (e.g., legal not engaged) and a communication timeline so reps can triage and repair the pipe
premises.evidence_span: What it's telling me is why this deal might not close

premises.text: Free Fortuit beta for sales reps installs without IT involvement in minutes
premises.evidence_span: I downloaded the Fortuit plug-in, let it run, and within five minutes, I was up and running. No IT involvement

value.text: Answer whether the rep or team will make the quarter and show managers the rep is in control

secondary_value.text: Give management transparency and control over front-office sales operations
secondary_value.evidence_span: the lack of transparency into front office operations, particularly sales

causal_links.evidence_span: If you don't know what's going on, you can't manage it
go all the way from, you know, I've got a problem with my pipeline, I'm not going to meet my quarter, to know exactly why

notes: Transcript opens mid-argument (truncated). 89% predictive accuracy treated as traction evidence of the engine, not a separate premise.
